p: proclaimed: This refers to the Lord, and not to Moses proclaiming: as Ex 33:19.
for it is a stiffnecked people: Seeing the people are of this nature, the rulers need to call on God that he would always be present with his Spirit.
snare in the midst of thee: If you follow their wickedness, and pollute yourself with their idolatry.
groves: Which pleasant places they chose for their idols.
molten gods: As gold, silver, brass, or anything that is molten: in this is condemned all types idols, no matter what they are made of.
at the year's end: Which was in September, when the days got shorter, that is, the end of their calendar year.
desire thy land: God promises to defend them and theirs, who obey his commandment.
seethe a kid in his mother's: See Ex 23:19, De 14:21.
forty days and forty nights: This miracle was to confirm the authority of the law, and should not be followed any more than other miracles.
before the LORD to speak with: Which was in the tabernacle of the congregation.
